anomalies.description: A vehicle (appears to be a dark sedan or SUV) enters the intersection from the right at high speed, fails to yield, and collides with another vehicle traveling straight through the intersection. The impact causes both vehicles to spin violently; debris is visible, and one vehicle skids across the road. This is a clear road accident involving a collision and loss of vehicle control.

A vehicle (dark sedan) enters the intersection at high speed from the left, fails to yield, and collides with a white van turning right. The impact causes the van to rotate sharply and skid across the intersection; debris is visible post-collision. Two pedestrians are crossing nearby and appear to react abruptly, indicating sudden danger. This is a clear road accident involving vehicle collision and loss of control.

A motorcycle is seen skidding and losing control near the intersection at approximately 10.0s–12.0s, then colliding with a white sedan that is turning right. The impact causes the motorcycle to fall onto its side, and the rider is thrown off (visible at 12.0s–13.0s). This constitutes a clear road accident involving vehicle collision and rider ejection.

A white sedan collides with a motorcycle at the intersection around 14.5s–15.5s; the motorcycle is struck and thrown sideways while the car continues forward with visible deviation in trajectory, indicating a crash.

A vehicle (dark sedan) enters the intersection from the right and collides with a silver sedan traveling straight through the intersection at approximately 25.5s–26.5s. The impact causes the silver sedan to rotate sharply and skid across the road, indicating a clear collision. No visible debris or fire, but the sudden change in vehicle trajectory and contact confirms a road accident.

A vehicle (white sedan) enters the intersection at high speed and collides with a bus turning right, causing the sedan to spin violently and skid across the road. Debris is visible, and the impact appears severe. Pedestrians near the crosswalk react by scattering. This constitutes a clear road accident with vehicle collision and loss of control.

A vehicle (appears to be a white sedan) is seen skidding sharply across the intersection at ~31.5s, losing control and rotating nearly 180 degrees before colliding with or coming to rest against the side of a stationary bus at ~32.5s. The motion is inconsistent with normal traffic flow and indicates a loss of control, likely a crash or near-crash event. Debris is not clearly visible due to resolution, but the abrupt, uncontrolled movement and impact with the bus strongly suggest a road accident.
